entities.summary: Tazin Ahmed (b. 1975-07-30, Royal Bengal Noakhali District) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Royal Bengal Noakhali District. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
